landing.hero_desc: Log expenses in seconds, schedule due dates, get WhatsApp alerts, and never forget a birthday or rent payment again.
landing.hero_fineprint: No credit card. No install. Privacy by design.
landing.features_title: Everything you need to stay in control
landing.feature_expenses_desc: Log an expense in 5 seconds. Filter by month, year, category or amount. 8 currencies with live conversion.
landing.feature_ocr_desc: Snap a photo of your receipt and AI extracts amount, merchant, date and category. You just confirm.
landing.feature_wa_desc: Automatic alerts before every due date, medical appointment or birthday. For you or your family.
landing.feature_reminders_desc: Medical appointments, birthdays, whatever you need. With configurable lead time.
landing.feature_metrics_desc: How much, on what, when. Charts by category, time evolution and month-over-month comparisons.
landing.feature_shopping_desc: Multiple lists (grocery, pharmacy). Tick items while you shop. Clear with one click.
landing.step1_desc: No passwords, no forms. One click and you're in.
landing.step2_desc: With the camera, by typing, or from a past receipt. Default categories included.
landing.step3_desc: Add your number and the ones you want. We'll alert you before every due date.
landing.final_cta_desc: Takes less time to start than to set up a spreadsheet.
